text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam reviews with senior army officers the readiness of air-defence units
- Minister of information says U.S. obstructs implementation of oil-for-food deal
- Arab foreign ministers denounce foreign intervention in Iraq's domestic affairs
- Russia's ultra-nationalist leader Vladimir Zhirinovsky and his liberal party demonstrate in front of U.S. embassy in Moscow in support of Iraq
- Demonstration in Turkey in support of Iraq
- Arab ambassadors in Cairo denounce moves touching on Iraq's sovereignty
- Demonstrations in Paris in support of Iraq
- Boom in trade between Kurdish north and other parts of the country
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and THAWRA)
- India prepared to supply Iraq with needs
- Oil ministry ships 1.2 million litres of oil products to the Kurdish city of Sulaimaniya
- Bulgarian firms to hold pharmaceutical exhibition in Iraq
- Editorial steps up criticism of U.S. and allied no-fly zones.
